description: This PHP source file defines the internal debugging plugin class for the Smarty templating engine. It contains methods for tracking and logging template compilation, rendering, caching times, and a method to display the debugging information through a web interface.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Debug
classes.description: A class responsible for collecting debugging data for the Smarty templating engine, including timing data for template processing, rendering, and caching, and providing a web-based debug console.

methods.name: start_template
methods.description: Begins the logging for a template's start time, updating internal counters and timestamps.

methods.name: end_template
methods.description: Ends the logging for a template's total processing time.

methods.name: start_compile
methods.description: Begins timing the compilation phase of a template.

methods.name: end_compile
methods.description: Ends timing the compilation phase and records the duration.

methods.name: start_render
methods.description: Starts timing the rendering phase of a template.

methods.name: end_render
methods.description: Ends timing the rendering phase and logs its duration.

methods.name: start_cache
methods.description: Begins timing the caching process for a template.

methods.name: register_template
methods.description: Placeholder for registering a template object with the debugger.

methods.name: register_data
methods.description: Placeholder for registering data objects with the debugger.

methods.name: display_debug
methods.description: Opens a debugging console in the browser to display collected template debugging data.

methods.name: get_debug_vars
methods.description: Recursively retrieves all variables and their scopes from a template or Smarty object.

methods.name: get_key
methods.description: Generates and returns a unique key for a template, used to index debug data.

methods.name: ignore
methods.description: Adds a template to the ignore list so its data is not tracked.

methods.name: debugUrl
methods.description: Handles URL query parameters to toggle debugging mode via browser.
